These declared axes are inert on this target: the collection/date contracts declare no axis-conditioned style rule the runtime could switch, and the target does not synthesize variant chrome. The axis value is stored as a declared prop only.
Display flags the runtimes store as inert declared props; the target does not synthesize the chrome they would switch on.
Delayed-appearance timers are consumer scheduling on this target; the runtime mounts content immediately and honours no delay.
Value formatting and syntax highlighting have no runtime on this target: there is no locale/number/date formatter and no tokenizer, so consumers format and tokenize before passing values.
Data-driven children (steps, options, filters, storage keys) are consumer-composed; the runtime does not iterate or persist them.
Structured object data (post/profile entities) is not modelled by any target runtime; consumers render their own fields.

URL/navigation-target props have no native meaning on this target; consumers handle navigation themselves.

rules.reason: Godot Controls have no CSS transitions, animations or transforms; state changes apply immediately, so transition/animation/transform declarations are not approximated.

rules.reason: box-shadow blur/spread has no StyleBox mapping in this projection; elevation is not approximated.

Opacity and visibility are declared under state selectors in the corpus; the runtime applies only unconditional declarations, so state-scoped effects are not claimed.
position/inset/z-index describe CSS layout and stacking; native containers own layout and the overlay layer owns stacking, so these declarations are not projected.

Cursor, user-select and resize declarations are authored per state; the control runtime has no state selector to switch them, so they are not projected (the uniform cursor subset is applied when declared unconditionally).
